title: From Prediction to Self: Developmental Conditions for Agency in Minimal Neural Systems
abstract: arXiv:2606.05605v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: How does a system that merely predicts the world come to distinguish its own causal influence from everything else? We trace this transition in a minimal 192-dimensional GRU through a developmental sequence -- 6 experimental stages, 12 falsified alternatives, and cross-signal validation. Starting with no action or self-representation, we add components one at a time, tracking whether the system distinguishes self-caused from world-caused changes. The central finding is the encoding gap: a system can perfectly compensate for its own actions in prediction while failing to encode "I am acting" as a readable state -- implicit causal use and explicit self-representation are dissociated capabilities. translated_title: 从预测到自我：最小神经系统中能动性的发展条件
translated_abstract: 摘要：一个仅仅预测世界的系统如何区分自身因果影响与其他一切？我们通过一个最小的192维门控循环单元（GRU）追踪了这一转变，历经一个发展序列——包括6个实验阶段、12个被证伪的替代方案以及跨信号验证。从没有行动或自我表征开始，我们逐步添加组件，并跟踪系统是否能区分自我引起的变化与世界引起的变化。核心发现是“编码缺口”：系统可以在预测中完美补偿自身行动，但未能将“我在行动”编码为可读状态——隐式因果使用与显式自我表征是分离的能力。当四个条件同时满足时，发展路径跨越了这一缺口：（1）形成稳定吸引子的持久状态，（2）将系统输出连接到输入的因果行动循环，（3）本体感觉反馈使……
tldr: 本文通过最小GRU系统的实验揭示了“编码缺口”现象，证明系统能隐式补偿自身行动但无法显式表征自我，并确定跨越该缺口需同时满足四个发展条件。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals an "encoding gap" in minimal GRU systems where implicit causal compensation for self-actions occurs without explicit self-representation, and identifies four jointly necessary developmental conditions to bridge this gap.
